Not in this slice: an empty OBFUSCATOR_DETERMINISTIC_KEY (stays unset), OBFUSCATOR_PASSPHRASE handling, the library ObfuscationEngine blank-key fallback, and README changes.

## Why

ResolveDeterministicKey returns a whitespace-only OBFUSCATOR_DETERMINISTIC_KEY unchanged, and ObfuscationEngine treats a whitespace-only key as no key, so auto string mode silently falls back to mapping and reports success. A blank --deterministic-key-file is already rejected (ob-08); the environment variable should fail the same way.

## Files

Obfuscator.Cli/ObfuscatorCliProgram.cs; Obfuscator.Tests/ObfuscatorTests.cs.

## Failing tests

obfuscate and deobfuscate with OBFUSCATOR_DETERMINISTIC_KEY set to a whitespace-only value (spaces, newline) exit 1 with "Deterministic key is blank." and write no output. An empty value is still treated as unset and obfuscate succeeds.

## Implement

In ResolveDeterministicKey, keep returning null for an unset or empty variable, and throw the same "Deterministic key is blank." InvalidOperationException for a whitespace-only value, with a message naming OBFUSCATOR_DETERMINISTIC_KEY instead of --deterministic-key-file.

## Check

Run the new environment-variable tests and the existing blank key-file and key round-trip tests, then dotnet test Obfuscator.slnx and scripts/test-local.sh.
